faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the Lenovo IdeaPad G40-30, G40-45, G40-70, G40-80, G41-35 and Flex 2-14D, which share the same chassis. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: No, this model does not come with backlighting from the factory, so we only stock the non-backlit version.
